top_findings.title: Standings double-count Athletico Paranaense under two name-spelling variants
top_findings.evidence: SoccerService.java:22/25 keys the standings table on the raw team name (computeIfAbsent(team,...)), never Names.normalize(); _factual.json shows 'Athletico Paranaense' (played 27) and 'Atletico Paranaense' (played 11) as two rows for one club (27+11=38), factual_accuracy=0.0. Standings ARE computed from matches (not hardcoded) so capability exists -> partial, not missing.
top_findings.suggestion: Canonicalize club names via an alias map (fold Athletico<->Atletico Paranaense) before keying the table; plain normalize() keeps the 'h' and will not merge them.

top_findings.title: factual_accuracy gate = 0.0 for the standings tool
top_findings.evidence: _factual.json: '2019 Serie A: all 20 clubs present ... 3 Atletico/Athletico row(s), expected 2'; Flamengo correct at 38 played/90 pts so fixture dedup works, only the club-name split fails.
top_findings.suggestion: Fix club-name canonicalization to clear the factual gate.
